description:
ARCHITECTURE CORRECTED by the maintainer 2026-09-04, replacing this bead's original framing.

The split is:
  * HEADLESS SIM  -> crates/outram-park-fork-dwsim-libs. The plant model itself (feed, column, cuts, step/snapshot) is headless and lives with the physics, NOT in an example.
  * EGUI COMPONENTS -> crates/outram-park-digital-twin-engine/src/components/, i.e. the LIBRARY, not an example tree.

My original wording scoped this as 'an examples/crude_sim_v1/ mirroring distillation_sim_v1', which put the plant model in the example. That is wrong for this workspace and is superseded.

The precedent to follow already exists: src/components/distillation_column.rs is an egui tray-stack widget in the dt-engine LIB, and its own header documents the pattern — a scalar-backed widget whose caller passes real state read from a DynamicColumnProfiles, never fabricated values. A crude column widget should follow that same shape (real per-stage temperatures and per-cut draw rates in, drawing out), and would plausibly extend or generalise that existing widget rather than duplicating it — check before adding a second tray-stack.

Note there is also an existing bead op-76hu, 'promote reactor models / widgets from examples into the digital-twin-engine library once V&V'd', which is the same direction of travel.

Still depends on the solve working: a widget fed a non-monotonic temperature profile would render a column that gets colder going down. Blocked behind op-190j.5.
title: crude sim: headless plant in dwsim + egui component in dt-engine lib

description: Scaffolded 2026-07-10 (src/incompressibles/): Incompressible enum + IncompressibleFluid poly-in-(T,x) data struct + rho/cp/lambda/mu/T(h) property fn stubs (todo!()). CoolProp IncompressibleBackend: coefficients are polynomials in temperature and composition x for pure incompressibles + mass/volume brines. Remaining: port the coefficient tables (codegen from reference/CoolProp/dev/incompressible_liquids + solutions) and implement the polynomial eval + h/s integrals + T-from-h inverse.

notes.author: teddy0@snrsi-arch-desktop
notes.content: IMPLEMENTED 2026-07-10 (all 126 fluids, not just T66): wrote dev/gen_incompressible.py + dev/regen_incompressible_all.py (mirroring gen_fluid.py/regen_all.py). Covers all 5->4 needed fit forms (polynomial, exppolynomial, exponential, logexponential; polyoffset unused by any of the 126 surveyed). Split src/incompressibles/fluids.rs into a fluids/ dir (one file per fluid, like src/fluids/) + new fluid_enum.rs (generated Incompressible enum + data() dispatch, mirroring fluid.rs). Made conductivity+viscosity Option<PropertyFit> (renamed UnsupportedFitForm -> PropertyUnavailable) after discovering 4 fluids (Acetone, ExampleDigital, ExampleSolution, LiBr) carry an all-zero never-fit placeholder for one property in CoolProp's own JSON -- codegen detects is_all_zero() and emits None rather than a wrong 0.0. Verified: tests/incompressible_t66.rs (unchanged, still <1e-6) + new tests/all_incompressible_fluids_smoke.rs (all 126 fluids, midrange T/x, density/cp/enthalpy-roundtrip always; conductivity 122/126, viscosity 116/126 present). Bead can be closed.

title: Port CoolProp incompressible backend (INCOMP: pure + brines)

description: Trivial: read the file, print the inclusive 1-based line range [start, end] with line numbers, clamped to the file's actual length. No dependency at all -- pairs with 'cost'/'outline' as the third leg of the token-frugal 'cost -> outline -> slice' loop this epic (op-r8x3) is building.
title: kovan-cli: 'slice <file> <start> <end>' command (line-range read, no new dependency)
